nuggets.text: The Blue Devils reached the FCS playoffs in 2024 and 2025, the first back-to-back trips in program history.
Head coach Adam Lechtenberg grew up in Butte, Nebraska, and played quarterback and defensive back at Nebraska.
Chris Jean is a Stats Perform FCS preseason first-team All-American after 13 pass breakups and four interceptions last year.
Adam Lechtenberg was a Blue Devils assistant earlier in his career before returning as head coach in 2023.
The Blue Devils and Rockets were set to play in 2020 until COVID-19 canceled it; Saturday is their first meeting ever.
Adam Lechtenberg's degree from Nebraska is in agribusiness.
The Blue Devils have climbed from NAIA to Division II to FCS, where they have played since 1993.
The Blue Devils first played in 1935 and fielded no team from 1942 through 1945.
The Blue Devils are two-time defending Northeast Conference champions and the coaches' pick to win it again.
The Blue Devils own eight Northeast Conference titles, most recently in 2024 and 2025.
